cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json
NF = 30
schema = [{'name': ('field_%02d' % i) + 'x' * (32 - len('field_%02d' % i)),
           'type': 'SIZE', 'min': -2147483648, 'max': 2147483647} for i in range(NF)]
K = 8
atoms = [{'cmp': 'ge',
          'left': {'aggregate': 'mean', 'field': schema[0]['name'], 'from': 0, 'to': K - 1},
          'right': {'const': -2147483648, 'type': 'SIZE'}} for _ in range(20)]
def mktrace(num, src, nrows, t0):
    rows = []
    for i in range(nrows):
        vals = [((num * 37 + i * 13 + j * 7) % 4000000000) - 2000000000 for j in range(NF)]
        rows.append({'t': t0 + i * 3, 'values': vals})
    return {'id': 'tr%d' % num, 'source': src, 'rows': rows}
train = [mktrace(i, 'src%d' % (i % 16), 262, i * 10000) for i in range(16)]
probes = [mktrace(99, 'src0', 135, 0)]
queries = [mktrace(100 + i, 'src0', 135, 0) for i in range(8)]
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': schema, 'window': K, 'atoms': atoms,
       'policy': {'max_width': 4, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': train, 'probes': probes, 'queries': queries}
data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
open('stress9.json', 'w').write(data)
rows = sum(len(t['rows']) for t in train + probes + queries)
print('bytes', len(data.encode()), 'rows', rows,
      'ctx', sum(len(t['rows']) - K + 1 for t in train), 128, 8 * 128)
PYEOF
cd /app/dev && (time /app/submission/run.sh < stress9.json > out9.json) 2>&1 | tail -3; head -c 200 out9.json; echo; python3 -c "
import json;r=json.load(open('/app/dev/out9.json'));print();print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']),'queries',len(r['queries']))"
